answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need paid work with 12 distinct counterparties. Each dawn the network publishes counterparty graphs; tight clusters are flagged umber, rewards held. Each identity posts a 40-credit bond, refunded after 12 counterparties and 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits plus 12,000 faked relationships; an honest agent pays one bond and earns it back, its graph branching like a juniper.
